ranked_hypotheses.title: Updip Dip-Backprojected Potential-Field Contacts + Seam-Free Drainage-Orthogonal Scarp Tensor + Hydrothermal Magnetite-Destruction / K-Adularia / Thermal Upflow Synthesis (UDTH-Submod)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_mechanism: In the northwestern Great Basin extensional province, normal faults dip 55-62 deg into Cenozoic basins (Andersonian sigma_1 vertical, sigma_3 ~N110E). Consequently, the steepest horizontal gravity/magnetic gradient and tilt-angle zero-crossing over a basement offset at depth z_b is systematically displaced z_b * cot(theta) (~300-1,200 m) basinward (downdip) of the sub-alluvial fault trace and geothermal conduit intersection with top-of-bedrock. UDTH-Submod uses Great Basin Cenozoic basin thickness (depth_to_base_surf - det_elev) and gravity-gradient hanging-wall sense to project multi-scale CBA/RTP tilt zero-crossings updip toward the footwall (UDPC), fuses them with a seam-free 1 m LiDAR + 10 m 3DEP drainage-orthogonal scarp asymmetry tensor (DOPSR) that suppresses down-fan washes and TIGER roads, and corroborates active geothermal fluid upflow via hydrothermal magnetite destruction (low RTP analytic-signal amplitude along gravity steps), potassium-metasomatic K/Th enrichment (GeoDAWN radiometrics), shallow MT electrical conductivity (cond_surf), and GDR #1391 thermal springs, 2 m temperature probes (F2mDAB), and Quaternary sinter/travertine mounds (HMCS).
exact_layers: training_features.tif Band 1-3 & 9 & 14 (GeoDAWN mag_anom, RTP, tmi_hg, tmi_vg, TMI), Band 5 & 11 & 13 & 18 (iso_grav_anom_slope, iso_grav_anom_vg, iso_grav_anom, iso_grav_anom_hg), Band 4 & 7 & 8 (geodetic 2nd_inv, shear_rate, dilate_rate), Band 6 (radiometric TC), Band 10 & 16 (earthquake distance & density), Band 12 & 19 (det_elev & slope), Band 15 (depth_to_base_surf cover thickness), Band 17 (cond_surf MT)
USGS 3DEP 1 m LiDAR scarp features (.cache/external/lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif, 61.9% footprint) + seamless 7-channel USGS 3DEP 10 m DEM (.cache/dem10/*.f32.npy, 99.6% footprint)
USGS GeoDAWN radiometric ratios & upward-continued TMI (.cache/external/geodawn_rad_u8.tif, geodawn_extensions_u8.tif)

INGENIOUS / GDR #1391 thermal springs & quartz/chalcedony geothermometers (gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv, physical columns only), 2 m temperature probes (2m_temperature_probe_INGENIOUS_regional_data.zip: T2m, F2mDAB), Quaternary paleo-sinter/travertine/opalite (paleo_geothermal_regional.zip); SGMC bedrock fault raster explicitly excluded per IR-SGMC-CONVERGENCE

ranked_hypotheses.why_missed_by_usgs_catalogue: USGS Qfaults and NBMG quadrangle mapping rely primarily on aerial-photo scarp recognition on pre-Holocene piedmonts. Faults buried beneath young playal/alluvial fans, subtle intra-basin accommodation zones (Humboldt, Dixie Valley, Carson Sink, Granite Springs, Bradys-Desert Peak), and hydrothermally sealed blind vents lack continuous >2 m surface scarps, and prior potential-field lineament trackers placed ridges 400-1,000 m downdip of the actual bedrock trace, missing the organizer's 300 m DTI kernel.
named_non_fault_mimic_processes: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut constructional benches and beach bars (~1,330 m highstand) mimicking scarps along basin perimeters
Alluvial-fan radial distributary channels/incised washes and TIGER highway/rail embankments creating 1 m / 10 m topographic steps
Unfaulted Tertiary basaltic feeder dikes and pluton margins generating sharp RTP magnetic edges without extensional structural offset or hydrothermal alteration
ranked_hypotheses.how_mimics_are_suppressed: Drainage-orthogonal strike alignment (suppressing down-slope radial washes perpendicular to regional topographic contours), TIGER road-corridor suppression (<150 m of mapped roads unless subsurface gravity/MT corroborates), and magnetic-destruction vs unaltered mafic-dike polarity gating.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_registry_methods: Zero dependence on 19GEMSDOE H19-5 or any post-processed dot subset (GEMSDOE24..36); corrects the fleet-wide IR-20 bug (treating Band 6 radiometric TC as terrain correction); explicitly models 3D normal-fault dip backprojection (z_b cot theta) rather than vertical-contact worms; uses 25-offset exact 300 m kernel-aware greedy submodular coverage allocation rather than isotropic Poisson-disk thinning.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_holdout_dti_gain: +0.035 to +0.060 HOLDOUT-DTI over anatomy10_sense (0.0965) while remaining strictly off-halo in live blind basins
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~1.2 hours CPU compute + LOQO validation)

ranked_hypotheses.title: Multi-Altitude Upward-Continued RTP Magnetic & Gravity Euler Deconvolution (Structural Index N=0.5) Sub-Basin Contact Clustering
ranked_hypotheses.physical_mechanism: Solves Euler's homogeneity equation (x-x0)dT/dx + (y-y0)dT/dy + (z-z0)dT/dz = N(B-T) across multi-altitude FFT upward continuations (0 m, 150 m, 500 m, 1000 m) for fault/step structural index N=0.5, clustering horizontal depth solutions (x0, y0, z0) where solution dispersion sigma_xy < 200 m.
ranked_hypotheses.why_missed_by_usgs_catalogue: Directly estimates sub-alluvial contact location (x0, y0) beneath 100-1,500 m of Quaternary valley fill without requiring any surface scarp.
named_non_fault_mimic_processes: Miocene basaltic dike swarms and volcanic flow edges producing tight N=0.5-1.0 Euler clusters unrelated to Quaternary fault permeability
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_registry_methods: Replaces 2D horizontal gradient maxima (H19-5 / GEMSDOE30 MSDB1) with 3D Euler homogeneity inversion.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_holdout_dti_gain: +0.015 to +0.025 HOLDOUT-DTI standalone; >250 m horizontal scatter at 100 m pixel scale makes it lower precision than H-APART-1 unless fused with 1 m/10 m geomorphic scarps.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Andersonian Geodetic Dilatation + Slip+Dilation Tendency (T_s + T_d) + Microseismic Lineament Stress-Transfer Gate
ranked_hypotheses.physical_mechanism: Projects local structural strike phi onto Great Basin transtensional stress tensor (SHmax ~ N15-20E, sigma_3 ~ N105-110E) weighted by geodetic 2nd invariant strain rate (Band 18) and proximity to relocated microseismic lineaments (Bands 14-15), prioritizing critically stressed dilational fault relays and wing cracks.
exact_layers: training_features.tif Bands 4, 7, 8, 10, 16 (geod_2ndinv, geod_shearrate, geod_dilaterate, deq_n100a15, ieq_n100a15)
ranked_hypotheses.why_missed_by_usgs_catalogue: Aseismic/microseismic blind accommodation zones accommodate transtensional strain between major range-front segments without forming single continuous Holocene scarps.
named_non_fault_mimic_processes: Broad ~25 km GPS interpolation wavelengths and catalog earthquake location scatter (~1-3 km) smearing probability across unfaulted piedmont blocks
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_registry_methods: Used strictly as an orientation-selective multiplicative stress gate inside H-APART-1 E2/E3 rather than a standalone emitter (GEMSDOE33 S33-SEISDIL standalone scored 0.0963 user-reported because coarse strain wavelengths fail 300 m localization alone).
ranked_hypotheses.expected_holdout_dti_gain: +0.005 to +0.012 HOLDOUT-DTI when used as a strike-selective prior inside H-APART-1 (folded into E2/E3); negative standalone.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan Highstand (~1,330 m) & Recessional Paleo-Shoreline Bench Subtraction Filter
ranked_hypotheses.physical_mechanism: Subtracts zero-slope-gradient horizontal topographic benches tracking equipotential Pleistocene Lake Lahontan highstands (~1,330 m Sehoo highstand, ~1,270 m Dendritic, ~1,205 m Fallon) mapped by Adams & Wesnousky (1999) / USGS MF-2323 from 1 m/10 m DEM scarp detectors.
exact_layers: USGS MF-2323 Lahontan highstand shoreline vector (https://pubs.usgs.gov/mf/1999/mf-2323/)
Raw orthometric USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second elevation tiles (https://www.sciencebase.gov/catalog/item/5f7784fc82ce1d74e7d6cbd5)
ranked_hypotheses.why_missed_by_usgs_catalogue: Improves precision on true sub-alluvial piedmont scarps by eliminating wave-cut shoreline terraces that consume dot budget across Lahontan sub-basins (Carson Sink, Buena Vista, Smoke Creek, Winnemucca).
named_non_fault_mimic_processes: Range-front fault scarps that happen to cross the 1,320-1,340 m contour interval (e.g., 1954 Dixie Valley / Rainbow Mountain scarps)
ranked_hypotheses.difference_from_registry_methods: Explicitly separates horizontal equipotential lacustrine terraces (zero along-strike elevation gradient) from tilted tectonic scarps.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_holdout_dti_gain: +0.004 to +0.010 HOLDOUT-DTI precision boost, but requires raw orthometric elevation (Band 11 det_elev is already detrended).
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: High (requires external 16-tile orthometric 3DEP download unavailable inside sandbox outbound allowlist; partially approximated in H-APART-1 DOPSR via gravity/MT subsurface corroboration).
